blurb: 423 Yoga offers a variety of yoga classes including Heated Vinyasa Flow, Hot Power Yoga, Heated Yoga Sculpt, Heated Mat Pilates, Yin Yoga, and special events like Sound Baths, Reiki, Kundalini, and SUP Yoga. Classes vary in intensity and temperature, with options for all levels. The studio provides showers and rentals for mats and towels.
